name: Google Workspace for OneAIWorkers
description: Protected Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets plugin with browser OAuth and automatic access-token refresh.
requirements: Google Cloud OAuth Web application client
Google Drive, Docs, and Sheets APIs enabled
capabilities: find, read, upload, organize, copy, share, and delete Google Drive files
create, read, search, and edit Google Docs documents
read, append, update, clear, and format Google Sheets ranges
refresh short-lived Google access tokens automatically without exposing the refresh token
use_cases: find and summarize files from Google Drive
create reports and shared documents from a chat
keep Google access working between chat sessions

credential_fields.label: Google OAuth Client ID
credential_fields.help: Create an OAuth client of type Web application in Google Cloud. The setup page shows the exact redirect URI.
credential_fields.help_uk: Створіть OAuth-клієнт типу Web application у Google Cloud. Сторінка налаштування покаже точну адресу повернення.

credential_fields.label: Google OAuth Client Secret
credential_fields.help: Stored only in encrypted D1 on your OneAIWorkers.
credential_fields.help_uk: Зберігається лише у зашифрованій D1 вашого OneAIWorkers.

credential_fields.label: Google refresh token
credential_fields.help: Created by Google sign-in, stored encrypted, and never shown in chat.
credential_fields.help_uk: Створюється під час входу через Google, зберігається зашифровано й ніколи не показується у чаті.
